summary: MCP-based agent architecture with single-source-of-truth JSON Schema, strict mode, transport-decoupled state, and post-2026-04-15 RCE-advisory security hardening. Archidraw is the reference implementation.

steps.title: Reference compliance audit
steps.verification: pnpm --filter @archidraw/mcp-server test + manual code review against Anthropic's writing-tools-for-agents checklist

steps.title: Security hardening (input validation, rate limit, origin, audit log)
steps.verification: 50 fuzzed inputs per tool — all return structured error, no crash. Rate limit test: 100 rapid calls returns 429 after threshold. Origin test: cross-origin request rejected.

steps.title: Cross-client verification + README docs
steps.verification: 5+ tool calls succeed from `claude mcp add` and `codex mcp add`. README has working copy-paste commands.

non_goals: Replace all existing tools in this repo with new MCP servers in one PR
Add OSS-local-model support that requires non-strict tool definitions
Replace archidraw's SSE bridge with full WebSocket duplex
Build a UI to view/manage the agent's tool surface
open_questions: Will Anthropic ship a 'MCP Apps' / UI capability? (rumored 2026-Q1)
Should we adopt the new 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP transport now, or wait?
Anthropic's writing-tools-for-agents post is 2025-09-11. Re-check at next major release.
